root_causes.#39: timeAgo/formatDateTime used luxon format 'LLL L'. In luxon 'L' is the MONTH NUMBER, so the day slot printed the month: every October date showed 'Oct 10', September 'Sep 9', August 'Aug 8'. Correct token for day-of-month is 'd'.
root_causes.#25: formatTimeExpires never checked whether the time had passed, so expired posts showed negative minutes ('-53251m').
root_causes.#40: CrudButton calls props.setPopped(true). Only HomeFeedPage (and NotificationsFeedPage) render a working ActivityForm; People/Messages pages have none, and UserFeedPage renders ActivityForm without setPopped. Fix: off the home page, navigate('/', {state:{compose:true}}) and HomeFeedPage opens the form.
root_causes.#24: NotificationsFeedPage fetched /api/activities/notifications, which returns hardcoded bootcamp demo data (a fake post credited to a real pilot user).
root_causes.#36: Forms counted value.length (UTF-16 units: an emoji = 2, family emoji = 11); backend counts Python len() (code points: 1 and 7). Array.from(value).length counts code points exactly like Python. Crud counter limit was 240 but the backend allows 280; reply counter was 240 but the backend allows 1024.
root_causes.#37: ActivityForm only console.logged a non-200 response, so a rejected post failed silently.
root_causes.#33: ProfileForm reported upload success/failure only to the console.

context.tested_by_claude: All 9 JS files pass a TypeScript JSX syntax parse (originals too). Hashtag regex tested: '#ChickenNoodleSoup', '#TOW', '#café_2' highlighted; 'C#' and a bare '#' not; text rejoins byte-identical. Array.from counts match Python len() for 😀 (1), 👍🏽 (2), family emoji (7). Not run in a browser — that is the operator's verify step after deploy.
